# Hellraiser Revival Wiki | Walkthrough, Codes & Guides

> Independent English-language fan guide for Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival.

## Scope

Source-linked summaries, not independently playtested. Artwork is illustrative and AI-generated, not gameplay footage. Opening walkthrough notes are not a complete campaign guide.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Persistent top navigation with direct guide links, reload-free page switching and a single current-page highlight; mobile shortcuts for Codes, Boss guide, Zora and All guides; search through the guide library, six categories and popular-guide links.
- [Guide library](/guides/): Page-based live search, category filters and saved guides; search/filter state persists in the URL for sharing and returning from articles.
- [What the game is & how to play](/beginners-guide/): What Hellraiser: Revival is, how its combat and puzzle boxes work, and the habits that make the first hours go smoothly.
- [Walkthrough: where to begin](/walkthrough/): Opening objectives, a first puzzle hint and a route to the full walkthrough.
- [Puzzle solutions: the first locks](/puzzles/): Two early mechanisms explained, with hints before the solution.
- [Collectibles & your firearm checklist](/collectibles/): The four collectible groups, missable-item advice and a saved firearm checklist.
- [All locker codes & safe combinations](/locker-codes/): Find ten reported cabinet, locker, safe and door codes by area, with location clues, optional reveals and copy buttons.
- [Sister of Mercy: boss guide](/sister-of-mercy/): Find the Sister of Mercy fight, prepare ranged weapons, survive the red arena and finish with Hellchains.
- [Zora: shops & buying guide](/zora/): Find Zora’s five shop stops, key weapon and recipe unlocks, buying priorities and the reported PS5 shop trophy issue.
- [How long to beat Hellraiser: Revival?](/how-long-to-beat/): Compare reported campaign times and the guided Platinum estimate, with practical advice for planning your play sessions.
- [Trophies: plan a safer completion run](/trophies/): Save planning, collectible requirements and the reported shop-trophy issue.
- [PC crashing: start with these checks](/crashing-fix/): Official PC requirements, Steam file verification and useful support details.
- [The Genesis Configuration](/genesis-configuration/): The puzzle box at the center of Aidan’s story and supernatural abilities.
- [About and editorial policy](/about/): Coverage, sources and affiliation.
- [Privacy](/privacy/): Browser-local storage, analytics and external links.

## Interactions

Header search and the / shortcut open the guide library and focus its search field, without a modal; optional solution and code reveals; lock-location search, area filters and direct jump links; code-copy buttons; local bookmarks; five-firearm checklist saved in browser local storage. No account, sync or advertising integration; aggregate usage measured with Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity on the published site only, disabled on local copies.

## SEO

Production origin: https://hellraiserrevival.help. Every page has an absolute, route-specific canonical in its initial HTML, matching Open Graph and structured-data URLs. Search and filter variants canonicalize to /guides/ without query strings or fragments. Homepage title: Hellraiser Revival Wiki | Walkthrough, Codes & Guides. Titles stay within 60 characters and unique page descriptions within 160; unknown pages are noindex and excluded from the sitemap.

## Maintenance

Guide data and source links: src/content.js. This file is generated by scripts/prerender.mjs during npm run build. Last content review: October 12, 2026.
